message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to incoming data; the pipeline passes images and strings through without structural validation.

No detected untrusted source handling: Remote resources are fetched via urllib/skimage io.imread and S3 without any checksum verification, signature validation, or pinned revisions to authenticate the source.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The pipeline performs image preprocessing and cell extraction but applies no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs on training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The KNN model is loaded via `knn.load_knn(filepath)` and a filepath from config without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to verify integrity.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample distribution before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection present anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanism is used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or stress tests are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although sklearn's confusion_matrix is imported in pipeline.py, there is no evidence of a held-out isolated test set, signed/hashed evaluation data, or multiple independent metrics being enforced to protect against metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: No input validation, shape checks, range checks, or schema validation are performed on incoming requests or image data before passing to the model pipeline.
No detected output bounds checks: The predict_knn function only remaps 0 to '.' but performs no probability sanity bounds, NaN guards, or threshold checks on model outputs.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a computer vision / Sudoku solving pipeline, not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
